author: Yasmin at-Sentinel

#The Ra Gada

When Yokuda sank, the warrior wave sailed east and landed on Hammerfell's shore. They were the Ra Gada, and they cut the land open and took it. Our grandmothers' grandmothers.

We remember them in the way we hold our blades.

#The Shehai

The greatest sword-singers could summon a blade from their own spirit: the shehai. It was not a weapon. It was the warrior's soul, given an edge.

Few can do it now. Those who try and fail say the shehai is still there; they simply have not listened hard enough.

#The Ansei

A master of the sword is called ansei. An ansei does not boast. An ansei does not need to.

If you meet one in the desert, bow, and do not draw. If they draw first, pray your sword has been listening to you.
